title: Stack On Two (The Hymn)
style: gospel pop, 96 BPM, hammond organ, warm choir backing vocals, soulful male lead, communal handclaps, uplifting anthem, strategy hymn, joyful build
lyrics:
[Intro]
We stack on two
We always stack on two

[Verse 1]
Even score, odd score, line them up the same
Lefty on the right, that's the strategy game
Don't follow the rule book, follow the geometry
Forehands in the middle, that's the family

[Pre-Chorus]
Switch when the serve goes
Switch when the return shows
Trade through the middle
Solve the geometric riddle

[Chorus]
Stack on two, stack on two
Forehands inside like the four-ohs do
Stack on two, stack on two
Even and odd, we line up true
Stack on two

[Verse 2]
Some folks line up the way the score says
We line up the way the forehand pays
Pre-stack, post-stack, half-stack too
Whatever it takes to keep the angle on you

[Pre-Chorus]
Switch when the serve goes
Switch when the return shows
Trade through the middle
Solve the geometric riddle

[Chorus]
Stack on two, stack on two
Forehands inside like the four-ohs do
Stack on two, stack on two
Even and odd, we line up true
Stack on two

[Bridge]
A stack is a promise
A stack is a plan
A stack says I trust my partner
And my partner trusts the man

[Outro]
We stack on two
We always stack on two
